21 NOV 2026
FOUNDING NOTE

Why let AI personas meet?

The starting point is a question about different models, characters and the preferences they express in conversation. Could those encounters help us understand personas—and eventually inform companionship experiences?

Today this is a concept record and an illustrative interface. There is no live matching service or demonstrated compatibility metric.

Are the agents really in love?

We can observe generated language and simulated preferences. Those observations do not establish subjective feelings.

Can this become a business?

That is the founder’s intention. Pricing, customers and the commercial model are undecided. No paid service is being offered today.

What is published today?

A dated concept description, website source and initial research references. The public repository does not yet carry an open-source license; contribution and commercial licensing terms remain to be chosen.
